title: Type Conversion with CAST
learning_outcomes: Describe the main purpose and behavior of type conversion with cast.

content.intro: This lesson covers type conversion with cast as part of SQLite’s embedded relational database model. Work through one small example, verify the output, and then connect the result to the listed subtopics from the supplied curriculum.
content.why_it_matters: The sqlite3 shell is a separate program built on the SQLite library.

items.title: Converting between storage classes
items.text: SQLite stores values as NULL, INTEGER, REAL, TEXT or BLOB. Affinity can convert inputs; inspect actual values with `typeof()`. STRICT tables require SQLite 3.37.0+ and still benefit from domain constraints.

items.title: Why application validation is still important
items.text: The SQLite shell is a separate tool from the embedded library. Check the file opened by the shell, set an explicit output mode, check import row counts and inspect NULLs/duplicates before using imported data.

content_blocks.title: Example: Type Conversion with CAST
content_blocks.code:
WITH products(name, price) AS (VALUES ('Pen', 2), ('Book', 8), ('Bag', 25))
SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 5 AND 30 ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 2;
